record.cardDesc: Record your actions for Agent reference
record.sectionHint: Generates a recording instruction — send it to your Agent to start recording your actions; the Agent can then use the resulting trace bundle to automate similar tasks.
record.promptTemplate:
Use BrowserSkill's `bsk` CLI to record the browser actions I'm about to demonstrate.

Steps:
1. Run: {{command}}
2. Once you confirm it's started, I'll operate in the opened window myself.
3. After I click Finish, read the written `./trace` bundle (`trace.json` + `states/`) and summarize what I did.

longScreenshot.cancelled: Capture cancelled. Your scroll position has been restored.
longScreenshot.runningHint: Keep this tab selected. You can close the popup, or pause to interact with the page. Reopen here to resume or finish early.
longScreenshot.previewHint: Saved locally. Preview tiles load as needed; downloading creates the full PNG. Save images you want to keep.
longScreenshot.missingDescription: This preview may have expired or been removed. Return to the webpage and capture it again from Quick actions.

errors.unsupported: Automatic scrolling is unavailable here. Try manual scrolling or the visible area.
errors.unavailable: The browser did not allow this capture. Click the extension again or check page access permissions.
errors.busy: Another task is using this page, or a capture is already running. Wait for it to finish.
errors.changed: The page changed during capture. Keep the tab, window size and page content stable, then try again.
errors.tooLarge: The browser could not process this image. Try adjusting the capture area.
errors.timeout: This page operation timed out. You can save the completed portion.
errors.captureFailed: Could not complete the screenshot. The page was restored. Please try again.
errors.saveFailed: Local storage is full or unavailable. Free up some space and try again.
errors.interrupted: Capture was interrupted. You can save the completed portion.
errors.storageFull: Local storage is full. Free some space; captured content is still available to preview and export.
errors.alignment: Could not align these frames reliably. Scroll back a little for more overlap, then scroll down slowly.
errors.autoUnavailable: Automatic scrolling could not start: this page does not allow extension scrolling, or its capture script could not connect. Refresh and retry, or choose “I scroll” or “Visible area”.

audit.title: Operation audit
audit.partialDescription: Recording started at {{time}}. Paused intervals were not recorded; see the timeline below.
audit.empty: No tasks recorded yet. Future BrowserSkill operations will appear here.
audit.disconnected: The local service is disconnected. Start the BrowserSkill service and retry. Existing history remains on your computer.
audit.unsupported: This local service does not support operation auditing. Update bsk and retry.
audit.requestFailed: Could not read or save audit history. Check local storage and task availability, or retry after the task ends.
audit.privacyShort: Saved locally for 30 days. Input content is hidden.
audit.privacyFull: History stays on your computer. Finished tasks are kept for 30 days. Input bodies, scripts, page text, and URL paths and parameters are not saved. Target names receive basic redaction. Exports contain the same redacted records.
audit.resultNote: “Operation completed” means the tool call completed, not that the website confirmed a business outcome. Missing results are marked “Outcome unknown”.
audit.deleteConfirm: Delete this task’s local audit history? This cannot be undone.

marker.paused: Recording paused · subsequent operations not recorded
marker.resumed: Recording resumed · previous interval not recorded

debug.title: Website debugging
debug.cardDesc: Record requests, errors and page context for later review
debug.capturePage: Page loads and context around actions
debug.retention: Records stay in this browser after tasks end and can be exported. Kept for 30 days, up to 50 records and 50 MiB total. Common credentials are redacted; bodies are bounded.
debug.disconnected: Connect the browser to start debugging.
debug.emptyHelp: Tell your agent the website and the issue. It can create a task and start capture.
debug.prompt: Use BrowserSkill website debugging. Start capture before visiting the page and reproducing the issue. Record requests, responses, console and page context; investigate using the evidence. Stop capture and export the results for me to review.
debug.noSession: This task has ended. Open history to review saved debugging records.
debug.chooseOperation: Select an action to inspect its evidence.
debug.correlation: Grouped by time. Temporal proximity does not establish causality.
debug.partial: Some context was unavailable, exceeded capture limits or was recovered from an interrupted checkpoint. Missing evidence does not mean nothing happened.
debug.truncatedBody: Body exceeded its limit; only bounded, redacted content was retained.
debug.missingBody: Body was not captured, was evicted, or is unavailable from the browser.
debug.coverageHelp: Captures this task tab and accessible frames after capture starts. Bodies and history are bounded. Worker-internal requests, WebSocket messages and earlier traffic are not included.
debug.coveragePartial: Some embedded frames have incomplete capture. Check other evidence before drawing conclusions.
debug.historyHelp: Keep the context behind every investigation. Review pages, requests and errors, or export records for your agent to analyze.
debug.deleteConfirm: Delete this debugging record? Previously exported files will remain.
debug.searchHistory: Search name, URL or record ID
debug.recordMissing: This record does not exist, was deleted or has expired.
debug.storageFailed: History could not be saved or read. Export the available data while it is retained.
debug.reason_browser_restarted: Browser or extension restarted; last checkpoint recovered
debug.exactFields: Only exact field names are linked
debug.noFields: No identifiable form fields were captured. Inspect requests and page evidence below.
debug.submissionHelp: Original field names are preserved. HTTP success does not establish business success. Different names are not linked. Summary: up to 12 requests / 96 fields; open a request for its retained body.
debug.noStructuredBody: No complete JSON or form body could be parsed. This does not mean no data was sent.
debug.noVisibleChanges: No difference in retained page text. Unrecorded moments and content are outside this observation.
debug.coverageNoScore: These field and text changes support observations, not a root-cause claim. Confirm causes against the API contract or source. Temporal proximity is not causality.
debug.waitingRequests: {{count}} requests are still pending; responses and later changes may be incomplete.
debug.observationWindow: Follow-up window: about {{seconds}} seconds, up to 4 changes; the next operation ends association.
debug.unsupportedCapture: Manual actions and fields cover standard main-page forms. Iframe actions, Shadow DOM fields, WebSocket messages and SSE chunks are not captured.
debug.noPrimaryRequests: No retained business requests for this operation; expand other resources below.
debug.gap_operation_running: Operation still running; results are incomplete.
debug.gap_operation_interrupted: Operation interrupted; do not treat it as completed.
debug.gap_capacity_limit: Capture capacity reached; some earlier evidence was evicted.
debug.gap_initial_load_not_recorded: Capture started on an open page; earlier loading requests cannot be recovered.
debug.gap_manual_capture_unavailable: Manual observation unavailable; the timeline may be incomplete.
debug.gap_interrupted_checkpoint: Recovered from an interrupted checkpoint; the latest changes may be missing.
debug.gap_observation_limit: Follow-up changes exceeded the limit; earlier observations were evicted.
debug.gap_before_unavailable: Page state before the operation was not captured.
debug.gap_after_unavailable: Page state after the operation has not been captured.
debug.gap_fields_partial: Fields are partial or unavailable; unidentified/custom controls may be missing.
debug.gap_page_truncated: Page text truncated; differences cover retained content only.
debug.gap_request_interrupted: Related requests were interrupted before completion.
debug.gap_intervening_operations: Other operations occurred before the later page. Its result cannot be attributed to this operation alone.
